verdicts.human_summary: buildModuleGraph() writes the entire module graph to stdout via console.log, which is noisy and can slow down large graphs. Should remove or route through debug flag.
The type of onModuleGraphChange should use NonNullable<Builder['onModuleGraphChange']> without the <Options> generic parameter to be more builder-agnostic.
Move this function into a separate/util file because exporting it from index.ts makes it available as a preset.
The type 'object' is too imprecise; should use a more specific interface type.
This should be a reusable utility that can be shared across other builders.
